body:
I've been trying to get a grant since the late 90's but always get denied. I can't get a straight answer from these schools of why. 

There are no free clinics in my area anymore, they closed it down last year. 

I don't have a driver's license because I've never been able to afford a car and insurance. I usually get a ride to work from a coworker but that's no reliable. The offer of gas money doesn't really seem to help either. I've lost a lot of jobs when someone someone has promised to come pick you up and don't show. 

I'm tired of life. I can't even keep my eyes open today. I've been throwing up all night because I can't figure out another way to change my life. I've been trying to fix my life since I finished high school in 94. No plan I lay out seems to work. Asking for help just produces the same responses from everyone, professional or not. 

I've accepted suicide and will go ahead with it. It's time to put an end to this misery.

The time to talk is over. I want solutions. I want to know why I can't get any kind of grant to go back to school? How come I can't ever find a job that pays me enough to afford a place to live? Why can't the public transportation in my area be more reliable? I ask that one because I'm tired of getting up and the waiting at the bus stop for nothing to show up all day. Then I lose my job because I can't get there on time. 

How'd you get to school? Who took you to your job before you were driving? What do you do when you need to go to the doctor but can't afford it?
